topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Rain’s been falling steady, the kind that makes the city look like a wet dream. Got a call from a friend, or so I thought. Turns out, I’ve been pouring my coffee and my sympathy into the wrong cup. This job, that prestige, all a front. Now, the streets are slick with more than just rain. Lies, they say, attract like wet cement. People get tangled, stuck. Maybe I should have seen it coming, the way the light skips off water, shiny and false. But here we are, me with a story that’s been soaked through, and a friend who’s nowhere to be found in the fog. Gotta wonder, next time, if I’ll be quicker on the draw, recognizing the weather for what it is.
